Class IuJsonbParser

java.lang.Object
iu.client.jsonb.IuJsonbParser
All Implemented Interfaces:
JsonParser, Closeable, AutoCloseable
final class IuJsonbParser extends Object implements JsonParser
Reports a JsonValue as JsonParser events, so a JsonbDeserializer can run in a tree conversion.

Walks the value in place, as JSON-P's own parser over a JsonStructure does, and like that parser reports an unknown location, since a value has no source text. position() identifies the parser state instead. For the same reason, getString() gives a number as the canonical text of its value, such as 2.5E+3 for 2.5e3.
